name: pi-scheduler
description: Scheduled prompts for pi: session timers with /once and /loop, and durable tasks with /schedule that run without an open session.
author: Eric Boehs
//peerDependenciesMeta: Optional so pi's git installer, which runs a plain `npm install` in the clone, does not pull a 140MB copy of pi in behind it. Nothing here imports pi at runtime; the peer only records which API the extensions are typed against, and CI installs it explicitly to typecheck.

pi.//: Explicit glob, not the extensions/ convention: lib/ holds shared modules that are imported, not loaded as extensions.
